Upper Text: When this card would be played, if there are 6 or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks, reduce the play cost by 6.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may place 1 yellow card from your hand as your top security card.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon suspends, by trashing your top security card, it unsuspends.
